title: When the docs are not enough
description:
Find the edge cases of `std::stoi` and write down where the docs answer them and where you had to test.

```
"42"     -> 42
"  42"   -> 42 (leading spaces skipped)
"42 "    -> 42, pos 2 (trailing text left)
"+7"     -> 7
"0x1A" base 16 -> 26
""       -> std::invalid_argument
"99999999999" -> std::out_of_range
```
hints: The page says `stoi` calls `std::strtol`, so `strtol`'s page answers questions about spaces and prefixes (lesson 5.03).
Wrap each call in `try` with separate `catch (const std::invalid_argument&)` and `catch (const std::out_of_range&)`.
requirements: Test at least ten inputs, catching both exceptions by type.
Print the `pos` output parameter to show how much was read.
For each result, write "documented" or "found by testing".
stretch: Compare with `std::from_chars` for the same inputs.
